dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。

colophons.text:
予素有怪石之僻。余友戴笠山人嗜予畫，亦猶予之嗜怪石焉。向故訂約，以所好相易。值余奔馳遷延，今夏偶憶及怪石之在吾齋已五載。繪此以踐前言。誌以奇峭為十二冊之終。時戊申六月六日，正齋閔貞謹識。

馆方英译：Inscriptions on Leaf 12 by the artist: 

I am quite fond of fantastic rocks. My friend Dai li shan ren [Wang Li 王禮] is quite fond of my painting, to the same degree as I love rocks. There has long been an understanding between us that we would exchange paintings for rocks [and vice versa]. At the time, I was traveling constantly. This summer, by chance I recalled our previous understanding, realizing that a fantastic rock [that he gave me] had been in my studio for as long as five years. Thereupon I painted this to fulfill my promise. I wrote this colophon and rendered a scene of tall and steep cliffs at the very end of this album of twelve leaves. This is the sixth day of the sixth month, of the year of wushen [1788]. Zhengzhai Min Zhen wrote this.

Six seals appearing on the leaves:

Min Zhen 閔貞; Zheng zhai 正齋; Qingqiao 青橋; Zhen 貞; Liao tang 蓼塘; Min Zhen zhi yin 閔貞之印。

正齋傳世真跡，應推此冊為第一。

馆方英译：The former collector Ding Nianxian's (丁念先, 1906–1969) statement on the album’s wooden cover:

This is a genuine work by Zhenzhai [Min Zhen]. It is ranked as the first and foremost among his extant works.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。
